## Smart E2E Test Selection

**Selected E2E tags:** ALL

**Selected Performance tags:** @PerformancePreps

**AI Confidence:** 100

### E2E reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

Hard rule seed mandates ALL due to locales/languages/en.json changes (copy feeds UI and E2E text/label selectors). The actual functional changes are narrowly scoped to the Perps margin adjustment flow: new usePerpsFreshRemovalLimit hook, updated usePerpsMarginAdjustment with live position fetching, updated marginUtils with price-move buffer, new usePerpsToasts entries, and UI updates in PerpsAdjustMarginView and PerpsAdjustMarginBottomSheet. The new locale strings ('no_removable_margin', 'remove_amount_changed_title', 'remove_amount_changed') could break E2E text/label selectors if any smoke tests assert on these strings. Without the hard rule, the targeted tags would be: SmokePerps (directly affected margin adjustment flow), SmokeWalletPlatform (required by SmokePerps — Perps is a section in Trending), and SmokeConfirmations (margin adjustments are on-chain transactions). The ALL selection is the conservative floor required by the hard rule.

</details>

### Performance reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

The changes modify Perps margin adjustment logic including position management hooks (usePerpsMarginAdjustment, usePerpsFreshRemovalLimit), margin calculation utilities (marginUtils.ts with new price-move buffer), and UI components (PerpsAdjustMarginView, PerpsAdjustMarginBottomSheet). The @PerformancePreps tag covers 'perps market loading, position management, add funds flow, and order execution' — margin adjustment is a core part of position management. The new getFreshRemovableMargin function adds an async getPositions call (skipCache: true) before submission, which could impact performance timing in the margin adjustment flow.

</details>
